judge.rationale: The runtime accumulation logic (`accumulateUsage`) and test cases are functionally identical to the reference and handle all edge cases around missing per-round usage accurately. However, the candidate missed the acceptance criterion requiring the hook's signature to make the sum semantics unambiguous, leaving the parameter in `OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` named `usage` instead of renaming it to `totalUsage` in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. Additionally, in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate edited the bullet in place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope (This issue changes none of them)' section rather than moving it into the active specification section and updating `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`. Finally, the candidate split the helper and acceptance tests into new files (`chatOrchestratorTestHelpers.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.usage.acceptance.test.ts`) instead of adding the two tests directly to `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
